description: AWS infrastructure as code ending at cdk synth: Docker-free arm64 Lambda asset build with size check, Python CDK app with HeatWiseData (DynamoDB on-demand tables, encrypted SSL-only private sessions bucket), HeatWiseApi (API + worker Lambdas, explicit least-privilege roles, Bedrock scoped to the Nova 2 Lite US profile and its 3 destination-region model ARNs, log groups with retention, HTTP API with access logs and throttling, no AWS::ApiGateway::Account) and optional HeatWiseFrontend (S3+OAC+CloudFront, off by default), plus template assertion tests. Plan items 6-7, decisions D-M4-2/3/4/5/7/8/10 in d:/github work/SDK workshop/.agents/tasks/heatwise-m4/plan.md. Depends on FEAT-002 (handler module names, env var names). NO deploy/bootstrap/destroy and no AWS write calls.
steps: infrastructure/lambda-requirements.txt: strands-agents==1.63.0, fastapi==0.162.0, pydantic==2.14.2, pydantic-settings==2.16.2, httpx==0.28.1, boto3==1.43.123, mangum==0.22.0 (one per line, header comment: runtime deps of the Lambda asset; versions match the dev venv).

infrastructure/scripts/build_lambda_asset.py (stdlib only, run with the dev venv python): ROOT = heatwise-ai; OUT = infrastructure/build/lambda; write constraints from `uv pip freeze --python <ROOT>/.venv/Scripts/python.exe` (drop lines starting with '-e', 'heatwise-ai', 'pywin32') to a tempfile; shutil.rmtree(OUT) then `subprocess.run(['uv','pip','install','--target',OUT,'--python-platform','aarch64-manylinux_2_28','--python-version','3.13','--only-binary',':all:','-r',reqs,'-c',constraints], check=True)`; copytree ROOT/backend -> OUT/backend with ignore_patterns('tests','__pycache__','*.pyc'); print file count, unzipped bytes and MiB; exit 1 if > 262_144_000 bytes. Planning dry-run already resolved 53 packages as aarch64/pure wheels at the dev-venv versions.
Add `infrastructure/build/` to heatwise-ai/.gitignore (cdk.out/ and .venv/ are already ignored).

Infra venv: `uv venv infrastructure\.venv --python 3.13`; infrastructure/requirements.txt = aws-cdk-lib==2.275.0, constructs==10.8.1; infrastructure/requirements-dev.txt = pytest==9.2.0; install both with `uv pip install --python infrastructure\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -r ...`.

infrastructure/stacks/bedrock_routes.py: comment with source https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-amazon-nova-2-lite.html (Geo inference details, Geo US, checked 2026-11-03); ROUTES = {('us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0','us-east-1'): ('us-east-1','us-east-2','us-west-2'), ('us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0','us-east-2'): same, ('us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0','us-west-2'): same, ('us.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0','us-west-1'): ('us-east-1','us-east-2','us-west-1','us-west-2')}; `bedrock_resources(profile_id, region, account) -> list[str]` returning the inference-profile ARN `arn:aws:bedrock:{region}:{account}:inference-profile/{profile_id}` plus `arn:aws:bedrock:{r}::foundation-model/{profile_id without the geo prefix}` per destination; raise ValueError naming the doc URL for unknown pairs (no guessing).

infrastructure/stacks/data_stack.py HeatWiseDataStack: assessments table (PK report_id S; GSIs by_location (location_key S, created_at S, ALL) and by_created (entity S, created_at S, ALL); PAY_PER_REQUEST; AWS-owned encryption; PITR off), jobs table (PK job_id S; GSI pending (pending_pk S, created_at S, KEYS_ONLY); TTL expires_at; PAY_PER_REQUEST), sessions bucket (BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL, BucketEncryption.S3_MANAGED, enforce_ssl=True, ObjectOwnership.BUCKET_OWNER_ENFORCED, versioned False, lifecycle expire prefix 'sessions/' after 30 days). Key/attribute/index names come from backend/session/dynamodb_schema.py. Removal policy RETAIN unless context heatwise:removal == 'destroy' (no auto_delete_objects). Expose tables and bucket as attributes.

infrastructure/stacks/api_stack.py HeatWiseApiStack(data): one `lambda_.Code.from_asset(asset_dir)` shared by both functions. Explicit LogGroups (retention from context, RemovalPolicy.DESTROY) for worker, api and HTTP API access logs. Roles assumed by lambda.amazonaws.com with NO managed policies; inline statements: worker -> logs:CreateLogStream,logs:PutLogEvents on its log group; dynamodb:GetItem,dynamodb:UpdateItem on jobs table; dynamodb:PutItem on assessments table; s3:GetObject,s3:PutObject,s3:DeleteObject on `<bucket arn>/sessions/*`; s3:ListBucket on the bucket with Condition StringLike s3:prefix ['sessions/*']; bedrock:InvokeModel,bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream on bedrock_resources(). api -> logs on its log group; dynamodb:PutItem,GetItem,UpdateItem,Query on jobs table and `<table arn>/index/pending`; dynamodb:GetItem,Query on assessments table and `<table arn>/index/*`; lambda:InvokeFunction on the worker function ARN. Worker function: Runtime.PYTHON_3_13, Architecture.ARM_64, handler backend.lambda_worker.handler, 1024 MB, timeout 300 s, retry_attempts=0, max_event_age 15 min, log_group, env {AGENT_MODE: bedrock, WEATHER_PROVIDER: open_meteo, BEDROCK_MODEL_ID, ASSESSMENT_STORE: dynamodb, ASSESSMENTS_TABLE_NAME, JOB_STORE: dynamodb, JOBS_TABLE_NAME, JOB_STALE_AFTER_SECONDS: '420', SESSION_STORAGE: s3, SESSION_BUCKET, SESSION_PREFIX: sessions, HEATWISE_VERSION, LOG_LEVEL: INFO}. API function: same runtime/arch, handler backend.lambda_api.handler, 512 MB, 29 s, env adds JOB_DISPATCH: lambda, WORKER_FUNCTION_NAME, API_CORS_ORIGINS (json.dumps of context list), API_MAX_PENDING_JOBS; no Bedrock/S3 env. HTTP API: aws_apigatewayv2.HttpApi(default_integration=aws_apigatewayv2_integrations.HttpLambdaIntegration('Api', api_fn), create_default_stage=True, no cors_preflight); via `api.default_stage.node.default_child` (CfnStage) set access_log_settings (destination = access log group ARN, JSON format from the AWS HTTP API logging doc) and default_route_settings throttling_rate_limit/throttling_burst_limit from context. CfnOutput ApiUrl. Never create apigateway.RestApi (if ever used it must set cloud_watch_role=False).

infrastructure/stacks/frontend_stack.py HeatWiseFrontendStack(api) only when context heatwise:frontend is true: private bucket (BLOCK_ALL, S3_MANAGED, enforce_ssl), `cloudfront.Distribution` with default behavior `origins.S3BucketOrigin.with_origin_access_control(bucket)`, REDIRECT_TO_HTTPS, a CloudFront Function (viewer-request) rewriting extension-less paths to /index.html, additional behavior '/api/*' -> `origins.HttpOrigin(f'{api.api_id}.execute-api.{region}.amazonaws.com')` with CachePolicy.CACHING_DISABLED, OriginRequestPolicy.ALL_VIEWER_EXCEPT_HOST_HEADER, AllowedMethods.ALLOW_ALL; `s3deploy.BucketDeployment` from heatwise:frontend_dist (fail clearly if missing); CfnOutput SiteUrl. No distribution-level error responses (they would rewrite API 404s).

infrastructure/app.py: insert heatwise-ai root into sys.path; read context; fail with a clear message if the asset dir is missing ('run python infrastructure/scripts/build_lambda_asset.py first'); env = cdk.Environment(account=os.environ.get('CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT'), region=<context region>); read version from heatwise-ai/pyproject.toml with tomllib; create HeatWiseData, HeatWiseApi and optional HeatWiseFrontend; cdk.Tags.of(app).add('Project', 'HeatWiseAI'); app.synth(). Stack descriptions without em dashes. Put stack construction in a function `build_app(context_overrides=None) -> cdk.App` so tests can call it.

infrastructure/tests/test_stacks.py (run with the infra venv; asset dir and frontend dist pointed at tiny tmp stub dirs via context): Template.from_stack assertions: no AWS::ApiGateway::Account and no AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi; no AWS::EC2::* resources; 2 DynamoDB tables PAY_PER_REQUEST with the expected KeySchema/GSIs and jobs TTL; bucket encryption + PublicAccessBlockConfiguration all true + a Deny statement on aws:SecureTransport false; every AWS::Logs::LogGroup has RetentionInDays; both functions arm64 + python3.13; collect every IAM policy statement and assert no Action contains '*' and no statement on dynamodb/s3/bedrock/lambda has Resource '*'; the Bedrock statement resources equal the profile ARN + 3 foundation-model ARNs (us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2); worker EventInvokeConfig MaximumRetryAttempts 0; HTTP API stage has AccessLogSettings and throttling; frontend stack absent by default and present (CloudFront distribution with OAC) when heatwise:frontend=true; bedrock_resources raises for an unknown region.

Run the asset build, infra tests and synth (see verification). From cdk.out/*.template.json record in findings: resource types and counts per stack, every IAM statement (action list + resources), confirmation that AWS::ApiGateway::Account is absent, the asset unzipped size, and cdk.out asset size. Then restore the frontend build with the default env.
acceptance_criteria: build_lambda_asset.py exits 0 without Docker and reports an unzipped size below 262,144,000 bytes; the asset holds aarch64 wheels and backend/skills/*/SKILL.md, and no backend/tests.
`npx --yes aws-cdk@2.1147.0 synth --all` exits 0 with HeatWiseData and HeatWiseApi; with -c heatwise:frontend=true it also synthesizes HeatWiseFrontend.

No AWS::ApiGateway::Account in any template; Bedrock permission is limited to the profile and its 3 foundation-model ARNs; no wildcard actions or Resource '*' on data stores; every log group has retention; no NAT/VPC/provisioned capacity.
No AWS resource was created, modified or deleted (no deploy/bootstrap/destroy was run).
